description: SPRINT_PLAN Amendment 10 with Addenda 10.1-10.3 (round 8, pre-registered 2026-11-01 before any round-8 run). Engine runs: B3 newhigh_c and B4 (FIN-H's entry, time_1100 calls with rvol >= 1.06, on d03-12t07 and n1d03-12t07 with exits (i) -95%, (ii) -50%, (iii) -50% + gb50, (iv) -50% + target +100%), SPY+QQQ+IWM pooled, desk fills, 2% half-spread ($0.005 floor), $0.65/contract/side, 1 contract, all out 15:25, one position at a time per run and symbol. 9 runs. No pass-2 robustness (tools/sprint_round8.py does its own checks). The option_pass section (D1-D6 grids, random-side twins, A-opt, A3 twins) is run by tools/sprint_round8.py, not by tools/sprint_run.py. DEV = 2024-08-01..2026-06-30, REAL Alpaca option prices (0DTE and next expiry; run with an empty --chains-dir so the pre-registered 2% MODELED-SPREAD is used, never logged 2026 chains).
